data.long_meaning: Chaaya is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Cha’ which means shadow or protection. This name is often used to denote someone who provides comfort and shelter. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Chaaya is believed to be the embodiment of shade and comfort, offering protection to her devotees. The name Chaaya carries the meaning “Shadow, protection” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chaaya usually hope their child will grow to embody shadow, protection and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Chaaya symbolizes a nurturing and protective presence. It is believed that the goddess Chaaya grants her devotees the strength to withstand adversity, just like a shadow offers comfort and relief from the scorching sun.
